data.alerts.yaml:
groups:
  - name: signal.availability
    interval: 15s
    rules:
      - alert: SignalGatewayUnavailable
        expr: probe_success{job="gateway-probe"} == 0
        for: 30s
        labels: {severity: critical}
        annotations:
          summary: Gateway cannot deliver the expected HTTP response
          runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#gateway
      - alert: SignalTargetDown
        # Static Loki target remains discoverable even when it is down.
        # Discovered workloads use the capacity rules below so an unready surge
        # Pod does not page while the required healthy replica count is present.
        expr: up{job="loki"} == 0
        for: 1m
        labels: {severity: warning}
        annotations:
          summary: The Loki scrape target is down
          runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#metrics
      # Count healthy targets, not all discovered Pods: a surge Pod during a
      # rolling update neither hides a missing replica nor causes a capacity alert.
      # The two-minute grace tolerates discovery/scrape changes during replacement.
      - alert: SignalNginxStableCapacityLow
        expr: (sum(up{job="nginx",release="stable"}) or vector(0)) < 2
        for: 2m
        labels: {severity: warning, job: nginx, release: stable}
        annotations:
          summary: Fewer than two healthy stable Nginx targets for two minutes
          runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#metrics
      - alert: SignalNginxCanaryMissing
        expr: (sum(up{job="nginx",release="canary"}) or vector(0)) < 1
        for: 2m
        labels: {severity: warning, job: nginx, release: canary}
        annotations:
          summary: No healthy canary Nginx target for two minutes
          runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#metrics
      - alert: SignalEnvoyCapacityLow
        expr: (sum(up{job="envoy"}) or vector(0)) < 2
        for: 2m
        labels: {severity: warning, job: envoy}
        annotations:
          summary: Fewer than two healthy Envoy targets for two minutes
          runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#metrics
      - alert: SignalNodeMetricsMissing
        expr: (sum(up{job="node"}) or vector(0)) < 1
        for: 2m
        labels: {severity: warning, job: node}
        annotations:
          summary: No healthy node-exporter target for two minutes
          runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#metrics
      - alert: SignalDiskLow
        expr: (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs",mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs",mountpoint="/"}) < 0.15
        for: 2m
        labels: {severity: warning}
        annotations:
          summary: Less than 15 percent free disk space
          runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#storage
      - alert: SignalProbeMissing
        expr: absent(probe_success{job="gateway-probe"})
        for: 2m
        labels: {severity: critical}
        annotations:
          summary: The synthetic check itself is missing
          runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#metrics

data.loki.yaml:
auth_enabled: false
server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
  grpc_listen_port: 9096
common:
  instance_addr: 127.0.0.1
  path_prefix: /var/loki
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory
  storage:
    filesystem:
      chunks_directory: /var/loki/chunks
      rules_directory: /var/loki/rules
schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: "2024-04-01"
      store: tsdb
      object_store: filesystem
      schema: v13
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h
storage_config:
  tsdb_shipper:
    active_index_directory: /var/loki/tsdb-index
    cache_location: /var/loki/tsdb-cache
ingester:
  wal:
    enabled: true
    dir: /var/loki/wal
compactor:
  working_directory: /var/loki/compactor
  retention_enabled: true
  delete_request_store: filesystem
limits_config:
  retention_period: 24h
  ingestion_rate_mb: 4
  ingestion_burst_size_mb: 8
  max_query_series: 1000
  allow_structured_metadata: true
analytics:
  reporting_enabled: false

data.blackbox.yaml:
modules:
  http_hello:
    prober: http
    timeout: 5s
    http:
      valid_status_codes: [200]
      method: GET
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
      headers:
        Host: signal.local
      fail_if_body_not_matches_regexp:
        - '^Hello World!'

data.alertmanager.yaml:
global:
  resolve_timeout: 2m
route:
  receiver: local-only
  group_by: [alertname, job]
  group_wait: 15s
  group_interval: 1m
  repeat_interval: 2h
receivers:
  - name: local-only
# Intentionally no external recipient. Alerts are visible in the local API/UI.

data.fluent.conf:
<system>
  log_level info
  workers 1
</system>
<source>
  @type tail
  @id app_container_logs
  path /var/log/containers/*_signal_nginx-*.log
  pos_file /buffers/containers.pos
  path_key source_file
  tag signal.web
  read_from_head true
  follow_inodes true
  refresh_interval 5s
  rotate_wait 10s
  <parse>
    @type regexp
    expression /^(?<time>\S+) (?<stream>stdout|stderr) (?<flag>[FP]) (?<log>.*)$/
    time_format %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%N%:z
    time_type string
  </parse>
</source>
# JSON access logs become searchable fields; text error logs remain in "log".
<filter signal.web>
  @type parser
  key_name log
  reserve_data true
  reserve_time true
  remove_key_name_field true
  emit_invalid_record_to_error false
  <parse>
    @type json
  </parse>
</filter>
<filter signal.web>
  @type record_transformer
  enable_ruby true
  <record>
    app web
    namespace signal
    pod ${File.basename(record["source_file"]).split("_").first}
  </record>
  remove_keys source_file,flag
</filter>
<match signal.web>
  @type loki
  @id loki_output
  url http://loki.signal-observe.svc.cluster.local:3100
  line_format json
  extra_labels {"project":"signal"}
  <label>
    app
    namespace
    pod
    stream
  </label>
  <buffer>
    @type file
    path /buffers/loki
    flush_mode interval
    flush_interval 2s
    flush_thread_count 1
    chunk_limit_size 1m
    total_limit_size 256m
    retry_forever true
    retry_max_interval 30s
    overflow_action block
  </buffer>
</match>
<source>
  @type monitor_agent
  bind 0.0.0.0
  port 24220
</source>
